RD_MOD_OVERDRIVE_KEYWORD.title: Overdrive
RD_MOD_OVERDRIVE_KEYWORD.description: Play a card even if you don’t have enough Energy. For each {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} you lack, add an [red]Out of Control[/red] to your Hand.
RD_MOD_PREPARATION_KEYWORD.title: Charge
RD_MOD_PREPARATION_KEYWORD.description: Your next Attack deals 50% more damage.
RD_MOD_FLIGHT_KEYWORD.title: Flight
RD_MOD_FLIGHT_KEYWORD.description:
Each stack of Flight reduces damage you take from enemy attacks by 1.
After an enemy attacks you, lose 1 Flight next turn.
